message.content:
An editorial illustration serves as a magazine cover. A man in a black suit, white shirt, and black-and-white patterned tie occupies the right foreground. He is smiling, with his right hand raised and palm forward. His left hand is positioned near his stomach. A thick, yellow industrial pipe emerges from his left suit pocket, emitting white steam. The background features a complex network of these same yellow pipes, curving and intertwining against a pale blue sky.

Large, white, capitalised text "TEMPO" spans the upper portion. Below this, smaller text reads "EDISI 26 AGUSTUS-1 SEPTEMBER 2013". To the left, large white text reads "JERO WACIK DIBIDIK". Below it, smaller text states: "Menelusuri dugaan penyelewengan gas Husky, KPK menemukan kasus suap Kernel. Menteri Energi terlibat?". In the top left, text reads "SEBAB POLISI DISASAR TERORIS", and in the top right, "KADER PARTAI DI MAHKAMAH KONSTITUSI". A red border frames the left side. A barcode and price "RP 33.000" are at the bottom left.
